verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਹਿ
verses.translit_en: sihajaa samai agiaan maan kai rasaae naeh

en.bdb: (A plea to make human life fruitful).

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਰਿਸਾਇ ਉਤ ਕੋ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: tanak hee mai risai ut ko sidhaare hai(n) ||

en.bdb: Due to my pride of youth, wealth and ignorance, I did not please my beloved Lord at the time of my meeting with Him. As a result He became cross with me and left me for some other place. (I was too preoccupied with enjoying my human life and paid no attention to meeting my Lord God).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰ ਮੀਜਿ  ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਧਿਕਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: paachhai pachhutai hai hai kar kar meej  moo(n)dd dhun dhun koT janam dhikaare hai(n) ||

en.bdb: After realising the separation of my Lord, I am now repenting and grieving and beating my head, am cursing my millions births of separation from Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੋਂ ਬਿਲਲਾਉ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖਤ ਹੁਇ  ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਆਤਮ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: aausar na paavo(n) bilalaau dheen dhukhat hui  bireh biyog sog aatam sa(n)ghaare hai(n) ||

en.bdb: I cannot get this chance of meeting my Lord for ever anymore. That is why I am wailing, feeling the distress and perturbation. The separation, its pangs and its worry is torturing me.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੀਜੈ ਲਾਲਨ ਮਨਾਇ ਦੀਜੈ  ਤੋ ਪਰ ਅਨੰਤ ਸਰਬੰਸ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਹੈਂ ॥੬੬੩॥
verses.translit_en: paraupakaar keejai laalan manai dheejai  to par ana(n)t saraba(n)s balihaarai hai(n) ||663||

en.bdb: O friend beloved of my Lord! do me a favour and bring around my separated Lord husband. And for such a favour, I will sacrifice all that I have many times over you.  (663)
